overall: The AG found the Board violated the OML by inadequately specifying executive session purposes, omitting documents from minutes, and approving official contracts only in executive session; it found no improper discussion of professional competence.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board entered executive session to discuss the professional competence of the Town Administrator, which the Purpose 1 exemption bars.
allegations.key_passage: We do not believe, as the complainant alleges, that the Board conducted a substantive discussion of Ms. Vinchesi's professional competence during its November 29, 2011 session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to state executive session purposes with sufficient specificity on six occasions in its notices and before convening.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board did not describe executive session topics with sufficient specificity on the meeting notices, and because the Chair failed to specify all topics that may be revealed without compromising the purpose for which the executive session was called prior to entering executive session, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's minutes did not list documents used in open session, such as items signed at the December 10, 2011 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to list the documents and exhibits used during the December 10, 2011 meeting in its minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board voted on employment contracts for three town officials in executive session and did not approve them in open session.
allegations.key_passage: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to vote on these three contracts in open session before executing the agreements.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
All Board members must review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Guide and certify to the AG's office within 30 days of receiving the determination.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Board that a determination of future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the Law.
